newsitem.title: USA: Fed official says US bond yields too low - I.D.E.A.
newsitem.headline: Fed official says US bond yields too low - I.D.E.A.

text.p: U.S. Treasury bond yields are "worryingly" low given the current tight labor market, a Fed official said, according to I.D.E.A. Inc.

I.D.E.A., an analytical service available on Reuters, said "a high-ranking Fed official" suggested that "although the relationship between low levels of unemployment and inflation appears to have broken down, the latest move down in long-term interest rates is of some concern."
That, I.D.E.A. added, is "implicitly suggesting that the market may have eased monetary conditions more than the Fed would have liked."
